shows.title: Divine Beyond The Flamingos
shows.venue: The Marjorie S. Deane Little Theater at The West Side YMCA
shows.description: Set in Harris Glenn Milstead aka Divine's NYC penthouse in early March 1988 as he packs for an incredible opportunity: a male role on a hit TV show. This dream of being recognized as a male actor has finally come true, but he notices that he has double-booked himself; he's to catch a plane in two hours, and he has invited his friends over to chat and party. What should he do? DO BOTH!
